dict.nffgirls.name: Mob Dictionary - By NFF: Girls
dict.nffgirls.landing_text: This guidebook introduces mobs involved in NFF: Girls, and how to interact with them.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.alraune:
The Alraune is a spirit of nature and plants, found in the Jungle biomes above Y=64.

It can perform 2 types of attack depending on the distance to its enemies. When the enemy is close, it performs melee attack, giving Poison II, Weakness III and Slowness III. If the enemy is far away, it can shoot poisonous seeds and give Poison I, Weakness I and Slowness I.

It is immune to Poison and Nausea effects.

It loves moisture. When it's in water or rain, it will gain Regeneration III. Oppositely, it's weak to fire damage.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.banshee:
The Banshee is a peculiar spirit which keeps a pose of buried face, found in the Taiga and Mountain biomes above Y=64.

It floats in the air and attacks by rushing to its prey. The attack gives Weakness and Hunger I.

It's an undead mob, and burns under the sun. It has 2 different textures.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.catoblepas:
The Catoblepas is a bull-like monster found on the Plain and Savanna biomes above Y=64.

Its attack has a strong knockback, and gives Blindness and Slowness II. It's immune to Blindness effect.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.creeper_girl: The Creeper Girl is a common mob which spawns occasionally in place of the Creeper in the Overworld. Its behaviors are similar to the Vanilla Creeper while the attributes are a bit higher. In addition, it has the sound of footstep, allowing you to hear its approach.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.crimson_slaughter:
The Crimson Slaughterer is a dangerous creature found rarely in the Crimson Forest.

It has higher attributes than most other mobs in this mod, and can step onto 3 blocks above, making it dangerous to fight closely against it. Its attack can cause Hunger II, Slowness I and Mining Fatigue I. It is arthropod, and weapons with Bane of Arthropod enchantment can deal it more damage.

The Crimson Slaughterer is highly adaptive for extreme conditions. It's immune to fire and falling damage, and Poison and Hunger effects. Also, it's resistant to projectiles, suffocation and Cactus.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.cursed_doll:
The Cursed Doll is a magical creature found in the Forest biomes above Y=64.

It holds a Wooden or Stone Axe as weapon. The attack has a strong knockback, can disable the shield, and deals Slowness I.

It burns under the sun, and is weak to fire damage. It falls slowly like the Chicken, and doesn't take falling damage. It can step onto 1.5 blocks above.

The Cursed Doll doesn't have the sound of footstep. Be aware of it's "surprise".
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.dodomeki: The Dodomeki is a monster from the legends of the eastern islands, found in the Taiga biomes above Y=64. Its melee attack gives Slowness I. It burns under the sun, although it's not undead.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.dogu:
The Dogu is an ancient automated golem warrior, found underground in the Jungle and Badland biomes.

It spawns with Stong or Iron Sword, and doesn't have the sound of footsteps. Its attack has a strong knockback, and gives Slowness II and Mining Fatigue II.

The Dogu can breathe underwater, and is immune to falling and Cactus damage. It's resistant to projectile, explosion, Powder Snow and falling blocks like the Anvil, but weak to the Pickaxe.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.drowned_girl: The Drowned Girl is a common mob which spawns occasionally in place of the Drowned in the Overworld. Its behaviors are similar to the Vanilla Drowned while the attributes are a bit higher.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.dullahan:
The Dullahan is a scary creature with a headless appearance, found in the Dark Forest and Mountain biomes above Y=64. It holds a Stone Sword as weapon, and the attack can gives Weakness I.

As a powerful fighter, it's resistant to magic. It burns under the sun, although not undead.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.dyssomnia:
The Dyssomnia is the leader of Phantoms. It's stronger than the Phantom, larger and more dangerous. It can be found in open biomes like the Plain, and the spawn chance depends on the phase of the moon. It's most likely to spawn under the full moon, and doesn't spawn at all under the new moon.

The Dyssomnia attacks by shooting magical bullets and gives Blindness. Also, it can summon Phantoms during the combat.

The Dyssomnia is immune to Blindness. Although undead, it doesn't burn under sun, but flies right upward and disappears.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.ender_executor:
The Ender Executor spawns occasionally in place of the Ender Man in the. They are rare in the Overworld and the Nether, but common in the End.

It's health and attack attributes are much higher than the Ender Man. It spawns with a Stone Sword, and other features are similar to the Ender Man.

Besides melee attack, the Ender Executor can also perform beam attack like the Guardian. The beam has very long tracking distance, but can be stopped by solid blocks.

Therefore, it's unadvisable to rashly provoke an Ender Executor.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.fortress_keeper:
The Fortress Keeper is a powerful golem made of Nether Bricks, and spawns in the Nether Fortress.

It can perform both close and distant attack. When its enemy is close, it will perform melee attack, making a strong knockback and giving Slowness I. When the enemy is far away, it can shoot projectiles causing fire and small explosions.

The Fortress Keeper is immune to fire, and resistant to projectiles, magic and Cactus.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.ghastly_seeker:
The Ghastly Seeker is a rare mob which only spawns in place of the Ghast in a small chance.

The features of the Ghastly Seeker are similar to vanilla Ghasts, but it has much higher attributes. Besides, the damage from its own fireball cannot immediately kill it but only deals twice damage.

As a Nether mob, it's immune to fire damage.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.ghost:
The Ghost is a hostile spirit in the darkness, found everywhere in the Overworld. It floats in the air, approaches the player slowly, and rushes to the player to perform melee attack.

Sometimes, the Ghost can spawn with a golden tool or weapon. It's undead and burns under the sun.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.giant_mummy:
The Giant Mummy is an ancient undead monster, found in the Desert biomes and the Desert Pyramids.

When attacking, the Giant Mummy can break some blocks nearby, and give Slowness I and Hunger. It's resistant to projectiles.

As an undead mob, the Giant Mummy burns under the sun.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.glaryad:
The Glaryad is a neutral mob found in the Lush Cave biomes. When attacked, it will alert other Glaryads nearby like the Zombified Piglin. Its melee attack gives Slowness I.

It loves moisture as a plant monster. When in water or rain, it will get Regeneration III effect. Oppositely, it's weak to fire damage.

You can hold a Mysterious Petal on your hand to attract the Glayrad. It will follow you if so, but can still be provoked if attacked.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.harpy:
The Harpy is a common creature found in the Plain, Savanna and Desert biomes above Y=64. Its attack has a strong knockback. It falls slowly like the Chicken and is immune to falling damage. It can step onto 1.5 blocks above.

The Harpy has 6 different common colors depending on the biomes. Besides, there's another hidden color that can be found anywhere but incredibly rarely.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.hornet:
The Hornet is a flying insect creature found in the Forest biomes above Y=64. It spawns with an Iron Spear and rushes to its prey to perform melee attack. Its attack gives Poison II when the difficulty is normal or above.

The Hornet is arthropod and is weak to Bane of Arthropod enchantment. It's also weak to fire.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.husk_girl: The Husk Girl is a common mob which spawns occasionally in place of Zombies in the Desert biomes. Its behaviors are similar to Vanilla Husks while the attributes are a bit higher.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.imp:
The Imp is a resident of the Nether, found in the Nether Wastes, the Crimson Forest and the Basalt Delta biomes.

It spawns with a Golden Fork. Its melee attack gives Weakness I and Mining Fatigue I when the difficulty is normal or above.

As a Nether mob, the Imp is immune to fire damage, and is resistant to falling and magical damages.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.jack_frost:
The Jack o' Frost is a spirit of the ice element, found in snowy biomes above Y=64. It attacks by shooting snow balls with damage. When it steps onto the water, it can freeze the water like the Frost Walker enchantment.

The Jack o' Frost is weak to the heat and fire damage. It will take damage in hot biomes like the Desert. It can get Regeneration I when in Powder Snow.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.jiangshi:
The Jiangshi is an undead creature from the eastern continent, found in the Bamboo Jungle biome above Y=64. It hops toward the enemies and performs melee attack. Its attack has a strong knockback and gives Poison I.

When a Jiangshi is damaged, its movement speed will be boosted, and return to normal gradually. If on fire or hit by the thunder, the speed will immediately return to normal.

It's resistant to projectiles. As an undead mob, it burns under the sun.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.kasha:
The Kasha is a cat-like monster found in the Nether Wastes, Soul Sand Valley and Basalt Delta biomes. It stalks to its prey silently and rush suddenly to attack. Its attack has a strong knockback and ignites the enemy.

When spawned on Soul Sand or Soul Soil, it will become a variation of soul fire, and be slightly stronger than normal ones.

The Kasha is immune to fire, but takes damage in water or rain. It's also immune to falling damage and can jump onto 2 blocks above. It's hostile to the Chicken and baby Hoglin.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.kobold: The Kobold is an underground miner creature, found in the dark places under Y=32. It spawns with a Stone Pickaxe. Its attack gives Mining Fatigue I when the difficulty is normal or above.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.lich:
The Lich is a powerful undead wizard living deep underground, found in the dark areas under Y=0.

It attacks by shooting magical bullets and can give Slowness I. When the enemy is close nearby, it also summons Vexes for help. Therefore, it's unadvisable to rashly approach the Lich if your equipment isn't strong enough.

The Lich is resistant to fire, magic and Powder Snow damage. It's undead, but can swim in water.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.magical_slime:
The Magical Slime is a variant of the Slime. When a Slime Girl is slain, some Magical Slimes of the smallest size are generated. The smallest Magical Slime can still deal damage. It's resistant to falling and magic damage.

It has 32 different colors like the Slime Girl, and drops Slime Balls when slain.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.melty_monster:
The Melty Monster is a spirit of the fire element, found in the lava in the Overworld and Nether.

It attacks by shooting Fire Charges like the Blaze. When a Melty Monster steps onto a solid block, it will ignite the block.

The Melty Monster is immune to fire, and takes damage in water. It escapes from the Strider and is neutral to players riding a Strider.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.monolith:
The Monolith is an ancient automated defensive device, found rarely in the Small End Islands and End Barrens, and commonly in the End City.

The Monolith doesn't move when it doesn't detect a player. It can perform 2 types of distant attacks depending on the distance of the enemy. When the enemy is far away, it performs beam attack like the Guardian, and gives Weakness I, Slowness I and Mining Fatigue I. When the enemy is nearby, it sprays smoke, causing Weakness II, Blindness, Slowness II, Mining Fatigue II and knockback.

The Monolith is resistant to fire, explosion, magic and Cactus, but weak to the Pickaxe.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.necrotic_reaper:
The Necrostalker is an undead creature living in the darkness, found below Y=0 in the overworld. It attacks with its scythe-shaped arms and gives Slowness I.

As an undead mob, it burns under the sun.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.nightwalker: The Nightwalker is a golem creature found in the Badland biomes above Y=64. It attacks by shooting magical bullets, giving Mining Fatigue I. As a magical golem, it's resistant to magic damage, but too heavy to float in water.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.ogre:
The Ogre is a strong monster living in the cave, found below Y=0 in the Overworld.

As a powerful creature, it can break blocks when attacking, causing a strong knockback and Slowness IV effect. It's highly resistant to suffocation and Cactus, and also resistant to projectiles, explosions, fire, falling, Powder Slow and falling blocks.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.redcap:
The redcap is a woodcutter creature found in the Dark Forest biomes above Y=64. It holds an axe as equipment, and sometimes also wears Iron or Chainmail Boots. The Axe attack can disable the shield.

When a Redcap is defeated, it can drop some Cureberry which can recover some health when eaten.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.savagefang: The Savagefang is a fierce and hostile fish found in the Swamp and Jungle biomes. They attack their prey in groups, and are hostile to players, animals, Villagers and even other hostile mobs. When the target is on the land, they can also jump out of the water to attack.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.scorpion:
The Scorpion is a fierce arthropod found in the Desert and Badlands biomes above Y=64. Its melee attack can give Poison I.

The Scorpion is immune to Poison effect. As an arthropod, it's weak to the Bane of Arthropod enchantment.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.skeleton_girl: The Skeleton Girl is a common mob which spawns occasionally in place of Skeletons in the Overworld. Its behaviors are similar to Vanilla Skeletons while the attributes are a bit higher.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.slime_girl:
The Slime Girl is a creature living in the wet places. They can be found in the Swamp and Mangrove Swamp biomes above Y=64. Its melee attack gives Slowness II effect.

It gets Regeneration III in water or rain, and is resistant to falling and magic damages.

The Slime Girl has 32 different colors.

When a Slime Girl is defeated, it has a chance to drop the Cubic Nucleus. This is a food which can give Regeneration I effect. However, it's more useful as an ingredient for making advanced items and the Potion of Regeneration III.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.snow_canine:
The Snow Canine is an animal living in the cold places. It's found in the Snowy Plains biomes above Y=64.

It attacks with a strong knockback, and is resistant to falling damage. It actively hunts Sheeps and Rabbits.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.spider_nest:
The Spider Nest is a mob as a nest of Cave Spiders, found in the dark area below Y=0 in the Overworld.

It can summon Cave Spiders besides melee attack, and also spawn Cave Spiders after death. Its melee attack gives Poison I and Slowness I.

The Spider Nest is immune to Poison, and resistant to projectiles, Cactus and explosions. As an arthropod, it's weak to fire and Bane of Arthropod enchantment. Its movement is not affected by the Cobweb.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.stray_girl: The Stray Girl is a common mob which spawns occasionally in place of Strays in the Overworld. Its behaviors are similar to the vanilla Stray while the attributes are a bit higher.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.swamper:
The Swamper is an octopus-like monster found in the Swamp and Mangrove Swamp biomes above Y=64.

It can perform both melee and distant attack. The melee attack can give Poison I and Slowness I. The distant attack (ink spraying) causes Blindness effect.

The Swamper can breathe underwater, and will suffocate in dry biomes outside water. It's weak to fire damage and resistant to falling.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.wither_ghost:
The Wither Ghost is a more dangerous variant of the Ghost found in the Nether. Its behaviors are the same as the Ghost in the Overworld, but the attack can give Wither I effect. Also, it's immune to Wither and fire damage.

The Wither Ghost has 5 different textures.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.wither_skeleton_g: The Wither Skeleton Girl spawns occasionally in place of the Wither Skeleton in the Nether. Its behaviors are similar to the vanilla Wither Skeleton while the attributes are higher. Rarely it can spawn with a Bow instead of a Stone Sword, and the arrows can ignite the target on hit.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.zombie_girl: The Zombie Girl is a common mob which spawns occasionally in place of Zombies in the Overworld. Its behaviors are similar to Vanilla Zombies while the attributes are a bit higher.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.alraune:
To get friendly with an Alraune, you need to right-click to give it items. To give, the mob must have Regeneration III effect for over 10 seconds, meaning you need Splash Potion of Regeneration III to satisfy the condition.

The Alraune's favorite items are Cureberries, Randomberries, XP Berries and Mysterious Petals, and also receives Spore Blossoms and other flowers.

After being friendly, it has 3 Bauble slots. It can shoot Poisonous seeds to the enemy, cause Poison I, Weakness I and Slowness I effects. The seed doesn't affect the owner, the owner's other monster girls and tamed animals.

When it sees an ally with health <50%, it can shoot a healing seed, providing healing by 1 and Regeneration I effect.

The Alraune can be healed with the Wheat Seed, Bone Meal and Spore Blossom. A Mysterious Petal can fully recover its health.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.banshee:
To get friendly with a Banshee, first you need to arrange a field of wither. You're required to be in the Wither effect, and there must be over 8 Wither Roses around you on the ground. Then you can right click to give it items.

Note that the friending progress will drop quickly when there aren't enough Wither Roses. If you're hit by the mob, you'll enter a cooling time of 60 seconds during which you cannot give any items to it.

Like most undead mobs, the Banshee loves Soul Cake Slices best. It also receives Soul Apples and Soul Powder.

After getting friendly, you can put items on its hands, and it has 3 Bauble slots. Note that the item on its off-hand cannot be stacked no matter what it is.

If it's holding a flower on the off-hand, it will provide effects depending on the flower type, same as the corresponding Suspicious Stew's effect. If the effect is positive, it will apply to the owner and allies within 8 blocks around; the negative effects will be applied on the enemy when hit.

Like most undead mobs, they can be healed with Rotten Flesh, Bone and Soul Powder. A Soul Apple can fully recover the health.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.creeper_gir:
To get friendly with a Creeper Girl, first you must right-click to give it items. It loves the Particle of Lightning best, and also receives the TNT and Gunpowder.

When the progress is full, it will stop moving, swell for 4 second with massive green star and smoke particles. After the 4 seconds, it will make a HUGE EXPLOSION (power 12). During this process, you must not get over 8 blocks away from the Creeper Girl, or the process will be interrupted, and you have to restart from giving items. You must survive from the explosion no matter how, and it will finally get friendly with you.

After getting friendly, you can equip armor and hand items to it. It also has an ammo slot which accepts Gunpowder or TNT. If it has ammo, it can approach the enemy and perform explosions. Gunpowder cannot break blocks but TNT can. Also, you can use a Particle of Lightning by Shift + Right-click to charge it, and its next explosion will have double power. Shift + Right-click your charged Creeper Girl to uncharge it and recover a Particle of Lightning.

Its explosions will not hurt itself, but can hurt any players and mobs. The explosions will not kill the owner's other monster girls or tamed animals, but can kill its owner.

The Creeper Girl can be healed with the Redstone, Gunpowder and Redstone Block.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.crimson_sla:
To get friendly with a Crimson Slaughterer, first you must suppress its hostility with Warped blocks before giving items. It must be standing on a Warped block. If so, it will get Slowness I effect, but the attack knockback will become very strong. Also, there must be >16 Shroomlight blocks around. If there aren't enough, the friending progress will drop quickly.

The Crimson Slaughterer loves the Nether Star, Netherite Ingot and Golden Apple best. It also receives the Shroomlight, Nether Wart, Crimson Fungus, Crimson Roots and Weeping Vines.

After being friendly, it has 4 Bauble slots.

If you're close to your Crimson Slaughterer, it will give you 1 hunger value each 10 seconds. Specially, if you're holding a Crimson Bow, it doesn't give but removes 1 hunger value until the hunger reaches 7, allowing you to make more damage with the bow.

The Crimson Slaughterer can be healed with the Crimson Fungus, Nether Wart and Shroomlight. A Golden Apple can fully recover its health.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.cursed_doll:
To get friendly with a Cursed Doll, you must fix its hurt with Wools and Strings. Give a Wool followed by a String to finish a "sewing" action. You need 8 such actions in total with a Wool of different color every time.

During this process, the Cursed Doll will keep hostile to you. If you're attacked, it will randomly drop a Wool you've given, and the corresponding "sewing" action will be cancelled.

After getting friendly, you can put items on its hands, and it has 6 Bauble slots. Although not undead, it can equip the Soul Amulet.

The Cursed Doll can be healed with the String, Lapis Lazuli, Emerald and White/Black/Gray/Light-Gray/Brown Wools. A Cubic Nucleus can fully recover its health. Wools of other colors cannot heal the mob, but give different effects with a shared cool time of 15s. Notably, the Pink Wool can remove all its negative effects.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.dodomeki:
To get friendly with a Dodomeki, you need to give it items by right-clicking. Before giving, you must have an Undead Affinity effect which can make it neutral. You can get this effect by eating Soul Cake or Soul Cake Slice, stepping on the Soul Carpet or wearing a Necromancer's Hat.

The Dodomeki's favorite item is the Soul Cake Slice. It also receives the Soul Apple and Soul Powder.

Note that once you provoke it during the friending process, no matter how, the process will be interrupted, and you have to restart from the beginning.

After getting friendly, it has 4 Bauble slots. Although not undead, it can equip the Soul Amulet.

It can be healed with the Soul Powder and Soul Apple.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.drowned_gir:
To get friendly with a Drowned Girl, you need to give it items by right-clicking. Before giving, you must have an Undead Affinity effect which makes undead mobs neutral. You can get this effect by eating Soul Cake or Soul Cake Slice, stepping on the Soul Carpet or wearing a Necromancer's Hat.

The Drowned Girl's favorite item is the Soul Cake Slice. It also receives the Soul Apple and Soul Powder.

Note that once you provoke it during the friending process, no matter how, the process will be interrupted, and you have to restart from the beginning.

After getting friendly, you can equip it with armors and hand items. It has 2 Bauble slots. It can also use the Trident.

The Drowned Girl can be healed with Rotten Flesh, Bone and Soul Powder. A Soul Apple can fully recover the health.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.dullahan:
To get friendly with a Dullahan, you need to give it items by right-clicking. Before giving, you must have an Undead Affinity effect which can make it neutral. You can get this effect by eating Soul Cake or Soul Cake Slice, stepping on the Soul Carpet or wearing a Necromancer's Hat.

The Dullahan's favorite item is the Soul Cake Slice. It also receives the Soul Apple and Soul Powder.

Note that once you provoke it during the friending process, no matter how, the process will be interrupted, and you have to restart from the beginning.

After getting friendly, you can modify its items on hands. It has 2 Bauble slots. Although not undead, it can equip the Soul Amulet.

The Dullahan can be healed with Rotten Flesh, Bone and Soul Powder. A Soul Apple can fully recover the health.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.ender_execu:
To get friendly with an Ender Executor, you must first provoke it by looking at its eye. Then you have to give items while resisting its attack. Note that hiding yourself behind blocks is not an option - the friending process will drop if it cannot reach you for over 10 seconds. Shield-block the attack instead. Also, getting over 8 blocks away from it will interrupt the process, and you have to restart from the beginning. This process is incredibly dangerous, and be sure to prepare well before doing this.

The Ender Executor's favorite item is the Ender Pie. It also accepts the Ender Plasm and Ender Eye.

After being friendly, you can equip items on its hands, and it has 2 Bauble slots. It also has a block slot, and the block in the slot will be held on its hand, but not giving any bonus in attributes now. Note that the block and off-hand slots are not compatible.

The Ender Executor can be healed with the Ender Eye and Ancient Stone.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.ghastly_see:
To get friendly with a Ghastly Seeker, you must first bring it to the overworld. When it's in the Overworld and can see the sky, you can right-click to give it items.

The Ghastly Seeker's favorite item is the Soul Cake Slice, and also accepts the Soul Powder and Soul Apple.

After getting friendly, the Ghastly Seeker has 4 Bauble slots. Although not undead, it can equip the Soul Amulet.

It requires ammo to shoot fireballs, either the Fire Charge and Blasting Bottle. The Fire Charge can make normal explosion and not break blocks. The Blasting Bottle can make larger explosion and break blocks. The fireball explosion will be also enhanced while its XP level increases.

The Ghastly Seeker can be healed with the Gunpowder, Soul Powder and Soul Apple.

If you have difficulties bringing it into the Overworld, you can try using the Reinforced Fishing Rod. This tool is similar to the vanilla Fishing Rod, but much more capable in pulling entities. When it hooks an entity, by right-clicking you can pull it multiple times without retrieving the hook, and the pulling force is also much stronger than the vanilla Fishing Rod. This action doesn't consume extra durability. Shift + Right-click to retrieve the hook. The Reinforced Fishing Rod can be repaired on the Anvil with the Reinforcing Chain. Indeed, you can fish with it as well.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.glaryad:
To get friendly with a Glaryad, you need to right-click to give it items. To give, the mob must have Regeneration III effect for over 10 seconds, meaning you need Splash Potion of Regeneration III to satisfy the condition. Also, you must hold a Mysterious Petal on the off-hand. Note that you must not have provoked the mob before.

The Glaryad's favorite items are Cureberries, Randomberries, XP Berries and Mysterious Petals, and also receives Spore Blossoms and other flowers.

After being friendly, the Glaryad has 3 Bauble slots. It can be healed with the Wheat Seed, Bone Meal and Spore Blossom. A Mysterious Petal can fully recover its health.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.harpy:
To get friendly with a Harpy, you must drop the item on the ground. It will pick the item up, watch it for a few seconds like the Piglin, and consume the item. As the progress increases, it will get Strength effect. Each 20% progress will provide 1 level of the effect.

The Harpy's favorite item is the Golden Apple, and also receives the Golden Tropical Fish and cooked meat.

After getting friendly, the Harpy has 4 Bauble slots. It can be healed with cooked meat. A Golden Apple can fully recover its health.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.hornet:
To get friendly with a Hornet, you must set up a field of honey before giving items. There must be 8 honey blocks around, otherwise the friendly progress will drop quickly. If you're attacked by the mob, you'll enter a cool time of 60 seconds during which you cannot give items.

The Hornet loves the Mysterious Petal and Honey Block. It also receives Honey Bottles and flowers.

After getting friendly, you can equip it with hand items, and it has 2 Bauble slots.

It can be healed with the Honey Bottle, Honeycomb and Honey Block. A Mysterious Petal can fully recover its health.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.husk_girl:
To get friendly with a Husk Girl, you need to give it items by right-clicking. Before giving, you must have an Undead Affinity effect which makes undead mobs neutral. You can get this effect by eating Soul Cake or Soul Cake Slice, stepping on the Soul Carpet or wearing a Necromancer's Hat.

The Husk Girl's favorite item is the Soul Cake Slice. It also receives the Soul Apple and Soul Powder.

Note that once you provoke it during the friending process, no matter how, the process will be interrupted, and you have to restart from the beginning.

After getting friendly, you can equip it with armors and hand items. It has 2 Bauble slots.

The Husk Girl can be healed with the Soul Powder and Soul Apple. Like the vanilla Husk, it will convert to the Zombie Girl after sinking into water for a few seconds. This conversion can be reverted with a Sponge.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.imp:
To get friendly with an Imp, you must drop the item on the ground. It will pick the item up, watch it for a few seconds like the Piglin, and consume the item.

The Imp's favorite items are the Nether Star and Golden Apple, and also receives the Golden Tropical Fish, Gilded Blackstone, Lemon, Crimson Fungus, Warped Fungus and Apple. When the progress reaches 70%, it will become neutral.

After being friendly, you can put item on its main hand, and it has 2 Bauble slots.

If it has a Netherite Fork on the main hand and a Tiny Netherite Scrap on the off-hand (metal nugget icon), it can locate the Ancient Debris nearby. If it locates an Ancient Debris, it will consume a Netherite Scrap, try to walk toward the block and generate a lot of green star particles. It locates the Debris only in the Follow mode.

The Netherite Fork can be obtained by upgrading the Golden Fork with a Netherite Ingot. If you have problems getting a Golden Fork, you can also make it on the Crafting Table, but it's really expensive.

The Imp can be healed with the Apple, Cookie, Pumpkin Pie, Lemon and Lemon Pie. A Golden Apple can fully recover its health.

(*Note: take care using Ancient Debris locating feature. Now block locating has issues which can cause a waste of metal nuggets.)
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.jack_frost:
To get friendly with a Jack o' Frost, you must drop the item on the ground. It will pick the item up, watch it for a few seconds like the Piglin, and consume the item.

The Jack o' Frost loves the Golden Apple, Golden Tropical Fish and HMaG berries. It also receives the Diamond, Emerald, Lapis Lazuli and Blue Ice.

After getting friendly, it has 4 Bauble slots. To make it immune to the hot biomes, it must equip a Resistance Amulet.

The friendly Jack o' Frost can also only attack by shooting snowballs. Upon the XP level increasing, the snowball's damage will be enhanced. When its XP level reaches a certain value, it will be able to shoot more snowballs each attack.

The Jack o' Frost can be healed with the Pumpkin Pie, Snow Block and Snowball. A Golden Apple can fully recover its health.

Mod compat: it receives Ice Bomb (The Twilight Forest).
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.jiangshi:
To get friendly with a Jiangshi, you must "tame" it in a style of the Taoist.

First you need to prepare some Taoist Talismans. Use a talisman on a Jiangshi will freeze its actions for 10s. When frozen, it will obtain 20 extra armor value. Then you need to attack it with a Peach-Wood Sword when it's frozen. After attacking, it will be immediately unfrozen and the talisman has a chance to be recovered. You need overall 6 hits to finish the process.

Each time you hit the Jiangshi, it will become stronger and release more smoke particles. After 3 hits, it will be hit by a thunderbolt, and it's knock-back will become really strong. After 6 hits, another thunderbolt will strike, and it's finally tamed.

Besides taming the Jiangshi, the Peach-Wood Sword is also a powerful weapon against the undead mobs. When hit an undead mob, it will deal damage with an amount 50% of the mob's maximum health, bypassing vanilla damage reducing mechanics. The extra damage will consume extra durability, and note that its durability is only equal to the Wooden Sword.

Specially, the hostile Jiangshi will not take the extra damage but get Weakness II effect. The friendly Jiangshi will take this damage.

After getting friendly, the Jiangshi has 4 Bauble slots. When it's thunder-struck, it will not take damage but get powerful effects, including Strength III, Damage Absorption III and Fire Resistance for 1 minute, and get 20 experience.

Like most undead mobs, it can be healed with Rotten Flesh, Bone and Soul Powder. A Soul Apple can fully recover the health.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.kobold:
To get friendly with an Imp, you must drop the item on the ground. It will pick the item up, watch it for a few seconds like the Piglin, and consume the item.

The Kobold loves metals, gems and pickaxes. When the progress reaches 70%, it will become neutral.

After getting friendly, you can set its hand items, and it has 2 Bauble slots.

Its main hand accepts only pickaxes. If the pickaxe has a Fortune enchantment, killing mobs will drop more items as if it had a Looting enchantment.

If it's holding a mineral nugget on the off-hand, it will help locate ores nearby. When finding an ore, it will consume a nugget, try walking to the ore and generate a lot of green star particles. Now it supports Coal, Copper, Iron, Gold, Lapis Lazuli, Emerald and Redstone. For Coal, Lapis and Redstone, it needs the mineral itself instead of the nugget. It locates ores only when in the Follow mode.

The Kobold can be healed with the Apple, Cookie, Pumpkin Pie, Lemon and Lemon Pie. A Golden Apple can fully recover its health.

(*Note: take care using ore locating feature. Now block locating has issues which can cause a waste of metal nuggets.)
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.melty_monst:
To get friendly with a Melty Monster, you need to be "Into Fire" before giving items. You must be either in the Lava or on fire, and NOT having a Fire Resistance effect. Each item given, you'll get Combustion effect for 30s.

The Melty Monster's favorite items are the Nether Star and Burning Core Block (1.19.2+). It also receives the Burning Core, Blaze Rod and Blaze Powder.

After getting friendly, it has 4 Bauble slots and a Lava Bucket slot. The Lava Bucket slot only receives Lava Bucket, and changes its behavior. If the Lava Bucket is present, its movement speed will increase on the ground, and will not try to return to the Lava.

The Melty Monster has a "Heat" property. It will consume "Heat" outside the Lava, and equipping a Lava Bucket can slow the consuming. The Heat will be restored when it's in Lava. If the Heat runs out, it will be unable to fire, its movement will slow down, and will try to return to Lava no matter if it's equipping a Lava Bucket. Its maximum Heat will increase while the XP level boosts.

It attacks by shooting fireballs like the Blaze. Each fireball consumes 5 Heat. When it reaches some specific XP levels, it will be able to shoot more fireballs in a single attack, and also consume more Heat.

Right click with a Water Bucket to prevent it from igniting its standing block. Use a Flint and Steel to enable igniting.

The Melty Monster can be healed with the Coal, Fire Charge and Blaze Powder. A Burning Core can fully recover its health.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.necrotic_re:
To get friendly with a Necrostalker, you need to satisfy it with the Necromancy. You need to be both wearing a Necromancer's Hat and holding a Necromancer's Wand.

Right-click with a Necromancer's Wand to shoot a magic ball. During the friending process, you must first make it stand onto the Soul Carpet somehow, and attack it with the magic ball. You need 6 hits overall. After each hit, it will get much stronger, and generates more smoke particles. This means it will be deadly if you're attacked by the Necrostalker after your several magic ball hits.

Note that hiding yourself behind blocks or escaping non-stop are not options. It's hit count will drop once it cannot reach you for 10s. Shield-block the attack instead. If you're too far from the mob (>32 blocks away), the process will be interrupted, and you'll have to restart from the beginning.

After getting friendly, you still need either wearing a Necromancer's Hat or holding a Necromancer's Wand to make it follow your commands. Otherwise, it won't follow you or attack your target, unless the favorability is above 90. To switch its AI or open its GUI, you also need a Necromancer's Wand instead of a Commanding Wand.

The Necrostalker's hand items can be customized, and only receive hoes as weapon. You can also put other items onto the off-hand but without any effects. Its attack damage will be boosted depending on the quality of the hoes. If the main hand hoe has a Fortune enchantment, killing mobs will drop more items as if it had a Looting enchantment. Also, it has 4 Bauble slots.

Like most undead mobs, the Necrostalker can be healed with the Soul Powder and Soul Apple.

The Necromancer's Hat's defense are the same as the Leather Hat, but also gives you Strength II and Haste II effects, as well as the Curse of Necromancy. The curse effect will slowly damage you, and the damage bypasses vanilla damage reducing mechanics. Standing on the Soul Carpet will prevent you from getting cursed. If your Necrostalkers are nearby when you're wearing the hat, they will give you the Regeneration effect, and the effect level depends on the amount of Necrostalkers (III at most).

The magic ball from the Necromancer's Wand can also damage mobs. When a magic ball hits a block or mob, it will burst and give Wither effect to mobs nearby. The Wither effect will be even stronger if the mob is directly hit by the magic ball. Your own Necrostalker will not take Wither but get healed and Strength effect. The Necromancer's Wand can be repaired on the Anvil with Death Crystal Powder.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.nightwalker:
To get friendly with a Nightwalker, you must first set up a field to boost its power before giving items. It must be standing on a Luminous Terracotta or Enhanced Luminous Terracotta. After giving, it will decay blocks it's standing on.

The Luminous Terracotta and Enhanced Luminous Terracotta are Terracotta variants which emit 7 and 15 light level respectively. The Luminous Terracotta can be obtained when a Nightwalker's magic ball hits a Glazed Terracotta block, or by crafting. The Enhanced Luminous Terracotta can be obtained only when a Nightwalker's magic ball hits a Luminous Terracotta block.

The Nightwalker loves the Cureberry, Randomberry, Experience Berry, and also receives the Ancient Stone and Clay Ball.

After getting friendly, the Nightwalker has 4 Bauble slots, and an ammo slot.

The ammo slot accepts Clay Ball and Ancient Stone. A Clay Ball can boost its magic balls' damage. An Ancient Stone can further boost the damage, and expand the range of converting blocks. It can fire without ammo.

The Nightwalker can be healed with the Clay Ball, Lapis Lazuli and Ancient Stone. A Golden Apple can fully recover its health.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.redcap:
To get friendly with a Redcap, you must drop the item on the ground. It will pick the item up, watch it for a few seconds like the Piglin, and consume the item.

It loves axes, the Golden Apple, Golden Tropical Fish and HMaG berries. It also receives the Bread and Wheat.

After getting friendly, you can equip them with armors (except the helmet) and hand items. It has 1 Bauble slot.

Its main hand slot only receives axes. If you're also holding an axe on the main hand, it will provide Haste effect of level depending on its holding axe: Below Diamond - Haste I; Diamond or equal: Haste II; Above Diamond (including Netherite) - Haste III.

It can be healed with the Apple, Cookie, Pumpkin Pie, Lemon and Lemon Pie. A Golden Apple can fully recover its health.

Mod compat: it receives Maze Map Focus (The Twilight Forest).
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.skeleton_gi:
To get friendly with a Skeleton Girl, you need to give it items by right-clicking. Before giving, you must have an Undead Affinity effect which makes undead mobs neutral. You can get this effect by eating Soul Cake or Soul Cake Slice, stepping on the Soul Carpet or wearing a Necromancer's Hat.

The Skeleton Girl's favorite item is the Soul Cake Slice. It also receives the Soul Apple and Soul Powder.

Note that once you provoke it during the friending process, no matter how, the process will be interrupted, and you have to restart from the beginning.

After getting friendly, you can equip it with armors and hand items. It has 2 Bauble slots.

It requires arrows to shoot, and can auto switch between the main and secondary weapons, either bows or melee weapons, depending on the distance to its enemy.

The Skeleton Girl can be healed with Rotten Flesh, Bone and Soul Powder. A Soul Apple can fully recover the health. Like the vanilla Skeleton, it will convert to the Stray Girl after standing in the Powder Snow for a few seconds. This conversion can be reverted by using a Flint and Steel.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.slime_girl:
To get friendly with a Slime Girl, you need to provide the Magical Gel by giving Magical Gel Balls or from Magical Gel Bottles. The gel in the Magical Gel Bottle has a color. The closer its color is to the Slime Girl's color, the more efficient it will be. The Magical Gel Ball is much less efficient (only 2-4% each), so it's recommended to use the bottle.

The Magical Gel Ball is a throwable item. If a thrown Magical Gel Ball hits a large vanilla Slime, it has a chance (25%) to generate a small Magical Slime of random color. If it hits a Slime Girl, it has a chance to generate a small Magical Slime of the complementary color of the Slime Girl. Hitting a non-slime mob will give a knock back and Slowness II for 30s.

The Magical Gel Bottle is an item for getting friendly with the Slime Girl, and modifying the color of friendly Slime Girls. Right-click a Magical Gel Bottle to a small Magical Slime to collect it as gel of the same color. If there's already content in the bottle, the color will be blended into the existing gel.

Each bottle's capacity is 6. If you're trying to collect a Magical Slime with a full bottle, the extra unit of gel will drop as a Magical Gel Ball after blending the color. Craft with an empty Magical Gel Bottle to divide the content into 2 bottles.

Also, crafting a Magical Gel Bottle with an HMaG mob ingredient can also modify its color.

When getting friendly with a Slime Girl with a Magical Gel Bottle, the progress provided by a single unit of gel depends on how close the gel's color is to the Slime Girl's color. Note that the progress may drop if you're using a color too far from its color. If the progress increases, it will generate green star particles; otherwise it generates angry particles.

To estimate the Slime Girl's color, you can hit it with a Magical Gel Ball to generate a Magical Slime of the complementary, collect it with an empty bottle and see the color.

After getting friendly, the Slime Girl has 4 Bauble slots. Its color can be modified with the Magical Gel Bottle, and after modification it has a chance to drop a Magical Gel Ball. Note that the magical gel's color will be blended with the Slime Girl's original color.

The Slime Girl can be healed with Slime Ball and Magical Gel Ball. A Cubic Nucleus can fully recover its health.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.snow_canine:
To get friendly with a Snow Canine, you must drop the item on the ground. It will pick the item up, watch it for a few seconds like the Piglin, and consume the item. As the progress increases, it will get Strength effect. Each 20% progress will provide 1 level of the effect.

The Snow Canine's favorite item is the Golden Apple, and also receives the Golden Tropical Fish and cooked meat.

After getting friendly, the Snow Canine has 4 Bauble slots. It can be healed with cooked meat. A Golden Apple can fully recover its health.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.stray_girl:
To get friendly with a Stray Girl, you need to give it items by right-clicking. Before giving, you must have an Undead Affinity effect which makes undead mobs neutral. You can get this effect by eating Soul Cake or Soul Cake Slice, stepping on the Soul Carpet or wearing a Necromancer's Hat.

The Stray Girl's favorite item is the Soul Cake Slice. It also receives the Soul Apple and Soul Powder.

Note that once you provoke it during the friending process, no matter how, the process will be interrupted, and you have to restart from the beginning.

After getting friendly, you can equip it with armors and hand items. It has 2 Bauble slots.

It requires arrows to shoot, and can auto switch between the main and secondary weapons, either bows or melee weapons, depending on the distance to its enemy.

The Stray Girl can be healed with Rotten Flesh, Bone and Soul Powder. A Soul Apple can fully recover the health.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.wither_skel:
To get friendly with a Wither Skeleton Girl, you need to give it items by right-clicking. Before giving, you must have an Undead Affinity effect which makes undead mobs neutral. You can get this effect by eating Soul Cake or Soul Cake Slice, stepping on the Soul Carpet or wearing a Necromancer's Hat.

The Wither Skeleton Girl's favorite item is the Nether Star and Soul Cake Slice. It also receives the Soul Apple and Soul Powder.

Note that once you provoke it during the friending process, no matter how, the process will be interrupted, and you have to restart from the beginning.

After getting friendly, you can equip it with armors and hand items. It has 2 Bauble slots.

It requires arrows to shoot, and can auto switch between the main and secondary weapons, either bows or melee weapons, depending on the distance to its enemy.

The Wither Skeleton Girl can be healed with Rotten Flesh, Bone and Soul Powder. A Soul Apple can fully recover the health.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.zombie_girl:
To get friendly with a Zombie Girl, you need to give it items by right-clicking. Before giving, you must have an Undead Affinity effect which makes undead mobs neutral. You can get this effect by eating Soul Cake or Soul Cake Slice, stepping on the Soul Carpet or wearing a Necromancer's Hat.

The Zombie Girl's favorite item is the Soul Cake Slice. It also receives the Soul Apple and Soul Powder.

Note that once you provoke it during the friending process, no matter how, the process will be interrupted, and you have to restart from the beginning.

After getting friendly, you can equip it with armors and hand items. It has 2 Bauble slots.

The Zombie Girl can be healed with Rotten Flesh, Bone and Soul Powder. A Soul Apple can fully recover the health. Like the vanilla Zombie, it will convert to the Drowned Girl after sinking into water for a few seconds. This conversion can be reverted with a Sponge.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.ancient_stone: A unique ingredient for Ancient Stone Blocks, Ancient suit, Ancient Shield and Nemesis Blade.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.burning_core: A unique ingredient for advanced items like Fortress Shield and Potion of Combustion. Entities with Combustion effect will be on fire during the whole affected time. It can also perform as a fuel.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.crimson_cuticula: A rare unique ingredient for Crimson Bow, Nemesis Blade and some other items. It can also be used to make the Potion of Voracity.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.cubic_nucleus: A food which can give Regeneration I effect. More useful as an ingredient for making advanced items and the Potion of Regeneration III.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.cureberry: A food item that can recover some health when eaten.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.dyssomnia_skin: A rare unique ingredient for insomnia items.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.ender_plasm: A unique ingredient that can be used to make advanced items like Endless Pearl and the Potion of Ender Rage.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.evil_crystal_fra: A basic ingredient for most items in this mod.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.experience_berry: A food that can give you some XP when eaten.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.golden_fork: A weapon slightly weaker than the Golden Sword. Can be upgraded to a Netherite Fork on the Smithing Table.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.iron_spear: A weapon slightly weaker than the Iron Sword.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.kobold_leather: A unique ingredient for making some items in this mod, and brewing the Potion of Kobold's Wisdom.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.lich_cloth: An important ingredient for making many advanced items like the Cloth of Purification, and Potions of Healing and Harming III.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.mysterious_petal: A unique ingredient useful to make advanced items like Enchanted Golden Apples.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.necrofiber: A unique ingredient that can be used to make the Necrotic Chainmail suit, which provides extra attacking speed.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.ogre_horn: The ingredient of the Potion of Ogre's Strength, giving Strength II and Haste I as well as Slowness II effects.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.randomberry: This food can give you a random effect for a short time, either positive or negative.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.sharp_fang: A unique ingredient for making some items like Reinforcing Chain, and also as the arrow head.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.soul_powder: A useful ingredient for many items in this mod.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.swamper_tentacle: A food that can be cooked and made into a stew.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.glowstone_dust: An occasional drop from the Ghost.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.magma_cream: A drop from the Melty Monster.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.wither_rose: An occasional drop from the Wither Ghost.
